prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: wide editorial photograph for a Deviny fitness-community landing-page section, replacing an app screenshot. Generate a single finished landscape photograph, approximately 1800 by 1000 pixels. No webpage, no mockup, no text.
Scene: a beautiful but believable small urban strength-training gym with pale warm concrete, tall daylight windows, a few dark metal weight racks in the softly focused background, uncluttered rubber floor.
Subjects: two fictional ordinary athletic adults about 28–35, a woman with dark hair in a simple ponytail wearing a muted mustard-gold training T-shirt and charcoal leggings, and a man with short dark hair wearing a plain charcoal T-shirt and dark shorts. They are training together. The woman is completing a comfortable controlled goblet squat with one modest kettlebell held correctly at chest height. Her training partner stands naturally nearby, engaged and encouraging without touching her, a relaxed genuine expression. Natural achievable bodies, not professional bodybuilders. A candid shared moment, nobody posing for the camera.
Composition: documentary 35mm environmental photography, eye-level, generous horizontal breathing room. Both people and their complete poses must fit comfortably inside the central 60% of the image, including hands and feet, so a center crop at 4:3 still works. People prominent enough to read clearly. Distinct separation between bodies, hands and equipment. Architectural window lines create quiet structure, no excessive background equipment.
Light and color: soft warm morning daylight with credible shadows, neutral cream, charcoal and restrained gold matching a refined Deviny visual identity. Real skin texture, real fabric, softly cinematic but not heavily graded. Premium contemporary sports editorial, emotionally inviting, grounded and unforced.
Constraints: anatomically coherent limbs and hands, realistic kettlebell handle and grip; no text, lettering, logos, watermarks, phones, UI, badges, diagrams, fake metrics, neon lighting or exaggerated muscles. Do not imply these are actual Deviny members.
processing: WebP encoding; small variant resized proportionally. No compositing or content edits.
usage: Editorial illustration of fictional adults training together. Not actual Deviny members, a testimonial, or a product screenshot.
